claim_text: Sen. Ruben Gallego, an Arizona Democrat and retired U.S. Marine, said on Sunday 16 August 2026 that he had spoken with the spouse of a Lincoln crew member three days earlier and blamed the prolonged deployment on the administration's failure to plan for the Iran war.
quote: The deep, deep, deep problem here is that this administration did not plan for this war, did not plan how to get out of this war, [and] did not really understand how this war was going to escalate.
confidence_justification: On-record assertion by an identified senator characterising administration planning; a political judgement, not an established fact.
